fixedRoundSwapDefinition: At original current q, four DISTINCT root-playable columns [a,b,c,d] denote p move a, o move b, p move c, o move d; swap two WHOLE p/o rounds to [c,d,a,b]. Both orders give identical original cell owners and hence identical final source q if no K-line completes inside block. The source guard checks that no current p surviving generator is a subset of {x_a,x_c}, and no o generator a subset of {x_b,x_d}.
validationEnvironment: Isolated V8 executing exact frozen repo source with dependencies bound from inspected frozen GitHub files; maintained Node26 CI and independent external checker NOT_RUN.
sourceClaimScope: Original two-round static path homotopy / endpoint q identity. DOES NOT license interchange of adaptive P1/P0 strategy quantifiers; the second move each player chooses may depend on what was observed after the first.
